entities.name: João Cabral
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: João Cabral, SJ was a Portuguese Jesuit missionary, who, along with Estêvão Cacella, were the first Europeans to enter Bhutan in 1627. The following year he became the first European to visit neighboring Nepal and the Sikkim region of India.
